sentences.vi: can / may / tend to / be likely to làm nhận định mềm. should / should not nêu lập trường. Tránh always, never, all khi chưa có căn cứ. must not ≠ don't have to.
sentences.exampleEn: A weekend job may teach teenagers to manage their time. Students who work every evening tend to feel tired in class.

ideas.vi: Chọn MỘT lập trường làm Claim (ví dụ: việc làm mùa hè phù hợp). Rồi chọn cụm How, Example, Result khớp lập trường đó.
ideas.exampleEn: Claim: summer jobs suit students → How: no homework, daytime shifts → Example: Khoa works at a café in July → Result: earn his own money

write.vi: Câu chủ đề và câu kết cùng một lập trường (should / should not). Ít nhất hai cách nói chừng mực. Bỏ all, always, never khi chưa có căn cứ.
write.exampleEn: Students should take summer jobs, because a few weeks of work may build confidence without harming their studies.

recall.vi: argue / claim / point out + that. recommend that + S + V nguyên mẫu. while nối hai quan điểm.
recall.exampleEn: Some teachers argue that homework should be shorter. They suggest that it be limited to thirty minutes.

write.prompt: Some secondary school students work part-time only during the summer holidays. Do you think a summer job is a good idea for them? Write a paragraph giving your opinion.
write.taskVi: đoạn 110–130 từ (mở rộng: 140–160 từ, không khung): lập trường rõ, lý do, minh họa, câu kết.
mustUse: should / should not ở câu chủ đề hoặc câu kết
ít nhất hai cách làm mềm nhận định (như can, may)
write.modelAfterSubmit: In my opinion, a summer job can be a valuable experience for secondary school students, as long as the work is safe and suitable for their age. During the school year, a part-time job often comes at the expense of study, because students who work late tend to arrive at school tired and may fall behind. In the summer holidays, however, they have no homework and can choose daytime shifts. A job in a café or a shop teaches them to talk to customers politely and to take responsibility for their tasks. Earning their own money also makes them more likely to spend it carefully. Therefore, secondary students should take a summer job, provided that the hours are reasonable and the workplace is safe.
